title: 第5章 螓首蛾眉冰肌绡
content_zh:
天秀宗一众人等才离开没多久，就又有一人走进了唐风的卧室。

莫流苏，天秀三代弟子第一人，林若鸢的亲传弟子，也正是刚才白素衣口中的莫丫头。

尽管在记忆中有过莫流苏的影子，尽管自从来到这个世界见到的女子无一不是容貌出众，让唐风看得目不暇接，可当莫流苏迈进来的那一瞬间，唐风还是短暂地失神了片刻。

一身青衣裹素腰，黛眼卷睫柳眉梢，娉娉袅袅从容步，螓首蛾眉冰肌绡。

玉为骨，冰为肤，秋水为姿月为神。手若柔荑，皓臂如玉！

有的时候语言显得如此苍白无力，莫流苏的美不带一丝人间烟火，仿佛滴落凡间的仙女。可又不是那么遥不可及，莫流苏身上更带着一种让人如沐春风一般的气质。

情不自禁地，唐风赞了一声：“美！”

莫流苏秀眉微蹙，以为这无赖男人又要如往日一般纠缠不休，若不是宗主之命在身，她怕是要转身离开此地了。尽管不喜欢这个男人，可听到唐风称赞自己，莫流苏白皙的脸颊上还是升起淡淡微红，强忍着心头的不快，来到唐风床边坐下，伸出芊芊玉手揭开唐风胸口的衣服。

“有劳了！”唐风知道别人心思，也不再多做纠缠。

待看到唐风胸口的伤势之后，莫流苏忍不住诧异地看了他一眼。放在平时，唐风若是稍微受了点伤，还不哭得死去活来？怎么今天伤势如此严重竟然都不吭上一声？

抬眼扫去，莫流苏更加惊诧了。唐风不但没有喊疼，甚至脸上丝毫痛苦的神色都没见到，仿佛那伤口不是自己的一般，那地方可是还在流血啊！

诧异归诧异，莫流苏还是将小手轻轻地放在了伤口之上。

下一刻，一团温暖无比的绿色光芒出现了，包裹着唐风受伤的位置，只是一瞬间，唐风就感觉到疼痛减缓了很多，不但身体上的疼痛，就连精神上的疼痛也纾解不少。

内力外放？唐风心头震惊无比！自己在唐门虽然是个不世出的奇才，可也没修炼到拥有内力的地步！就连唐门里那几个功力最深厚的老家伙，也无法将内力外放到这种程度。莫流苏才多大年纪？怎么可能做得到？而且这内力的颜色居然是绿的。一时间，唐风傻乎乎地盯着那团绿光震惊无比。

渐渐地，胸口变得痒了起来，唐风入目之下，竟然看到伤口以一种诡异的速度在愈合，最外缘的地方已经开始结咖，伸手一碰，血咖便掉落了下来。

见到唐风这般孩子气的举动，莫流苏也有点想笑。

“你不疼么？”为了避免自己真的会笑出来，莫流苏只能开口找点话说。

“疼。”唐风老老实实地答道，“但是美女在面前，就算疼也不能喊出来。”

莫流苏脸颊上又升起一片红晕，赶紧闭口不言，这个无耻的男人，果然给他三分颜色就要开染坊。

唐风看得有趣，每次自己一夸她，她就脸红，而且脸红起来特别好看。

治疗的过程是很短暂的，才不到一刻钟时间，胸口处的伤口竟然已经全部愈合，只留下一道痕迹。

莫流苏叮嘱了几句，让唐风这几天好好调养便转身离开了。这不禁让唐风感到有些郁闷，暗怪自己这具身体的人缘实在太差了。

才躺了一会，林若鸢又去而复返，心疼无比地安慰了唐风几句，懊恼无比地说道：“若不是姑姑当年开玩笑说你和小婉有缘分，你也不会整日缠着她了，今日更不是遭此磨难，说起来还都怪我。”

见林若鸢自责，唐风也赶紧劝解了几句。

林若鸢走后，唐风这才有时间好好静下心来，通过这具身体的记忆好好了解一下这个世界。刚才发生了那么多事，唐风全都一知半解，最主要的原因还是没有彻底融合这具身体的记忆的缘故。

花了半夜时间，唐风终于理出了头绪。

这具身体的前主人之所以那么不招人喜欢，还真怪不了别人，要怪也只能怪自己。

唐风自小就生活在天秀，而整个天秀上至宗主，下至普通弟子，全是女人，没一个男性存在，再加上林若鸢本就对抚养孩子没什么经验，见唐风小时候长得粉雕玉琢甚是惹人喜爱，就把他当女孩来养。

养来养去，唐风的性格也变得越来越女性化，等林若鸢发现之时已经纠正不及。

想想看，一个半大男孩，成天打扮的花枝招展，粉黛秀眉的，任谁看到都会觉得别扭。小时候还好，毕竟孩子小，打扮的漂亮也招人喜欢，可是唐风今年都十五岁了，说起话来嗲声嗲气，以至于天秀三代弟子没一个人喜欢他。

别人越不喜欢他，越是排斥他，唐风就越象是橡皮糖似的粘着别人。这样只能形成一个恶性循环，天秀三代弟子从最开始的不喜欢，渐渐到讨厌唐风，最后是厌恶！

那个叫秦小婉的三代弟子，是和唐风从小一起长大的。在唐风十岁的时候，林若鸢见他们两人关系比较密切，无意中开了个玩笑，说唐风和小婉年纪一般大，很有缘分，不知道会不会成为夫妻。

这仅仅只是个玩笑，没想到唐风把这个玩笑当真了，从那以后就对秦小婉特别上心。前些日子听说秦小婉在外结识了一个男子，关系很密切，唐风恼怒之下便去找对方理论，对方虽然忌惮唐风背后的天秀没对他怎么样，可唐风回到天秀之后就莫名其妙地晕倒了。

所以天秀弟子讨厌唐风，也不尽是别人的错。唐风本人占了相当一部分责任，林若鸢也有责任，毕竟孩子是她抚养的。

至于莫流苏的内力外放，唐风也总算明白了其中的玄奥。

整个天罡大陆，能够修炼罡气的人，被称为罡士！罡士分几等，最低等的便是炼罡期！炼罡期共分九品，秦小婉就是炼罡六品的实力，而莫流苏身为天秀三代弟子第一人，已经到了炼罡九品的境界，再往上，便是天地玄黄四大阶位！天地玄黄同样分上中下三品，每提升一品都要付出莫大努力，资质不好的人，根本无法窥探黄阶的奥秘，更不要说玄阶，地阶，天阶了。

更有传说，在天阶之上，还有更厉害的人物。
content_en:
Not long after everyone from Tianxiuzong left, another person walked into Tang Feng's bedroom.

Mo Liusu, the first disciple of Tianxiu's third generation, Lin Ruoyuan's direct disciple, is also the Mo Yatou that Bai Suyi mentioned just now.

Although there was a shadow of Mo Liusu in his memory, and although all the women he had seen since coming to this world were of outstanding appearance, Tang Feng was dazzled by them, but the moment Mo Liusu walked in, Tang Feng was still briefly distracted for a moment.

Wearing a green robe with a plain waist, she has dark-green eyes with curly eyelashes and willow eyebrows. She is walking calmly, her eyebrows are slender and her skin is silky.

Jade is the bone, ice is the skin, autumn water is the posture, and the moon is the god.Her hands are as soft as catkins, and her arms are as bright as jade!

Sometimes words seem so pale and feeble, and Mo Liusu's beauty is without a trace of human fireworks, like a fairy dripping from the mortal world.But it's not that unreachable, Mo Liusu has an aura that makes people feel like a spring breeze.

Tang Feng couldn't help but praise: "Beautiful!"

Mo Liusu frowned slightly, thinking that this scoundrel man would continue to pester him as before. If it weren't for the order of the sect master, she would probably turn around and leave this place.Although she didn't like this man, when she heard Tang Feng praising herself, Mo Liusu still had a faint blush on her fair cheeks. Holding back the unhappiness in her heart, she came to sit beside Tang Feng's bed and stretched out her jade hands to uncover the clothes on Tang Feng's chest.

"Thank you!" Tang Feng knew what others were thinking and didn't bother anymore.

After seeing the injury on Tang Feng's chest, Mo Liusu couldn't help but look at him in surprise.Normally, if Tang Feng was slightly injured, wouldn't he cry to death?Why didn't you say a word when your injuries were so serious today?

Looking up, Mo Liusu was even more surprised.Not only did Tang Feng not cry out in pain, he didn't even see any pain on his face, as if the wound was not his own, but the place was still bleeding!

Surprised, Mo Liusu gently placed his little hand on the wound.

The next moment, a ball of extremely warm green light appeared, wrapping Tang Feng's injured area. In just a moment, Tang Feng felt that the pain had slowed down a lot. Not only the physical pain, but also the mental pain was relieved a lot.

Release your inner strength to the outside?Tang Feng was extremely shocked!Although he is an extraordinary genius in the Tang Sect, he has not yet cultivated to the point of possessing internal power!Even the old guys with the most profound skills in the Tang Sect are unable to exert their inner strength to this extent.How old is Mo Liusu?How is it possible?And the color of this internal force is actually green.For a moment, Tang Feng stared stupidly at the green light, extremely shocked.

Gradually, his chest became itchy. When Tang Feng took a closer look, he saw that the wound was healing at a strange speed. The outermost edge had begun to gather blood. When he reached out and touched it, the blood coffee fell down.

Seeing Tang Feng's childish behavior, Mo Liusu also wanted to laugh a little.

"Don't you feel pain?" In order to avoid laughing, Mo Liusu could only find something to say.

"It hurts." Tang Feng replied honestly, "But in front of a beautiful woman, even if it hurts, you can't shout out."

A blush rose on Mo Liusu's cheeks, and he quickly kept silent. This shameless man would open a dyeing workshop if he was given three points of color.

Tang Feng found it interesting. Every time he complimented her, she would blush, and her blushes were particularly beautiful.

The treatment process was very short. In less than a quarter of an hour, all the wounds on the chest had healed, leaving only a trace.

Mo Liusu gave Tang Feng a few words to take good care of himself in the past few days, then turned and left.This can't help but make Tang Feng feel a little depressed, secretly blaming his body for being so unpopular.

After lying there for a while, Lin Ruoyuan came back again, comforting Tang Feng with a few words of distress, and said with great annoyance: "If my aunt hadn't joked that you and Xiaowan were destined, you wouldn't have been pestering her all day long, and you wouldn't have been in this ordeal today. You still blame me."

Seeing Lin Ruoyuan blaming herself, Tang Feng quickly tried to persuade her.

After Lin Ruoyuan left, Tang Feng had time to calm down and understand the world through the memory of this body.So many things happened just now, and Tang Feng barely understood them all. The main reason was that the memory of this body had not been completely integrated.

After spending half the night, Tang Feng finally figured it out.

The reason why the previous owner of this body was so unpopular was really no one else's fault. If he had to blame it, he could only blame himself.

Tang Feng has lived in Tianxiu since he was a child, and the entire Tianxiu, from the sect master to the ordinary disciples, are all women, and there is no male. In addition, Lin Ruoyuan has no experience in raising children. Seeing that Tang Feng was very cute when he was young, he raised him as a girl.

Over time, Tang Feng's personality became more and more feminine, and by the time Lin Ruoyuan discovered it, it was too late to correct it.

Think about it, a half-grown boy who dresses up all day long and has beautiful eyebrows will feel awkward to anyone who sees him.It was okay when I was a child. After all, the child was young, and he was well-dressed and liked by others. However, Tang Feng was already fifteen years old this year, and he spoke in such a coquettish voice that no one among Tianxiu's three generations of disciples liked him.

The less others liked him and the more they rejected him, the more Tang Feng clung to others like a gummy candy.This can only form a vicious cycle. The three generations of disciples of Tianxiu disliked Tang Feng at the beginning, gradually grew to hate Tang Feng, and finally became disgusted!

The third-generation disciple named Qin Xiaowan grew up with Tang Feng.When Tang Feng was ten years old, Lin Ruoyuan saw that the two of them had a close relationship and accidentally made a joke, saying that Tang Feng and Xiaowan were about the same age and were very destined. She wondered if they would become husband and wife.

This was just a joke. Unexpectedly, Tang Feng took the joke seriously and became particularly interested in Qin Xiaowan from then on.A few days ago, I heard that Qin Xiaowan had met a man outside, and they had a very close relationship. Tang Feng was angry and went to argue with the man. Although the man was afraid that Tianxiu behind Tang Feng did not do anything to him, Tang Feng fainted inexplicably after returning to Tianxiu.

Therefore, it is not entirely other people's fault that Tianxiu disciples hate Tang Feng.Tang Feng himself took a considerable part of the responsibility, and Lin Ruoyuan was also responsible. After all, she raised the child.

As for Mo Liusu's inner strength, Tang Feng finally understood the mystery behind it.

Throughout the Tiangang Continent, those who can cultivate Gang Qi are called Gang Shi!There are several levels of Gangshi, and the lowest level is the Gang-refining stage!The refining stage is divided into nine levels. Qin Xiaowan has the strength of the sixth level of refining. Mo Liusu, as the first disciple of Tianxiu's third generation, has reached the ninth level of refining. After that, he reaches the four major levels of heaven, earth, xuanhuang!Heaven and Earth Xuanhuang are also divided into three levels: upper, middle and lower. Each level requires great efforts. People with poor qualifications cannot pry into the secrets of Huang level, let alone Xuan level, earth level and heaven level.

There are even legends that there are even more powerful people above the heavenly level.
